sloka: राम उपरोध व्यथिताम् रक्षो हरण कर्शिताम् ।अबलाम् मृग शाव अक्षीम् वीक्षमाणाम् ततः ततः ॥५-१५-३५॥
transliteration: rāma uparodha vyathitām rakṣo haraṇa karśitām ।abalām mṛga śāva akṣīm vīkṣamāṇām tataḥ tataḥ ॥5-15-35॥

translations.english: The fawneyed lady was looking here and there with her dark, curved eyelashes. Her unhappy face was streaming with tears.
